title: antsCorticalThickness.sh
description: This script performs T1 anatomical brain processing including brain extraction, brain n-tissue segmentation, cortical thickness estimation, and optional registration to a template.

brain_template.description: Anatomical intensity template. This template is not skull-stripped.
brain_template.title: Brain segmentation template

brain_extraction_probability_mask.description: Brain probability mask in the segmentation template space. A binary mask is acceptable.
brain_extraction_probability_mask.title: Brain extraction probability mask

brain_segmentation_priors.description: Tissue probability priors corresponding to the template image specified with the -e option. At least four priors must exist, corresponding to CSF, Cortical GM, WM, Subcortical GM.
brain_segmentation_priors.title: Brain segmentation priors

output_prefix.description: Output prefix for the generated filenames.
output_prefix.title: Output prefix

image_file_suffix.description: Any of the standard ITK IO formats e.g. nrrd, nii.gz (default), mhd.
image_file_suffix.title: Image file suffix

template_for_t1_registration.description: Anatomical intensity template. This template must be skull-stripped.
template_for_t1_registration.title: Template for T1 registration

extraction_registration_mask.description: Binary metric mask defined in the segmentation template space (-e). Only used in brain extraction registration.
extraction_registration_mask.title: Extraction registration mask

atropos_prior_segmentation_weight.description: Atropos spatial prior probability weight for the segmentation (default = 0.25).
atropos_prior_segmentation_weight.title: Atropos prior segmentation weight

number_of_segmentation_iterations.description: N4 -> Atropos -> N4 iterations during segmentation (default = 3).
number_of_segmentation_iterations.title: Number of segmentation iterations

posterior_formulation.description: Atropos posterior formulation and whether or not to use mixture model proportions. e.g 'Socrates[ 1 ]' (default) or 'Aristotle[ 1 ]'.
posterior_formulation.title: Posterior formulation

use_floating_point_precision.description: Use single float precision in registrations (default = 0).
use_floating_point_precision.title: Use floating-point precision

use_random_seeding.description: Use random number generated from system clock (default = 1).
use_random_seeding.title: Use random seeding

use_b_spline_smoothing.description: Use B-spline SyN for registrations and B-spline exponential mapping in DiReCT (default = 0).
use_b_spline_smoothing.title: Use B-spline smoothing

cortical_thickness_prior_image.description: Cortical thickness prior image in the template space, with an estimated upper limit of cortical thickness at each voxel.
cortical_thickness_prior_image.title: Cortical thickness prior image

label_propagation.description: Incorporate a distance prior on the posterior formulation.
label_propagation.title: Label propagation

additional_priors_for_thickness.description: Add segmentation classes for thickness estimation.
additional_priors_for_thickness.title: Additional priors for thickness

script_stage_to_run.description: Which stage of ACT to run (default = 0, run all).
script_stage_to_run.title: Script stage to run

test_debug_mode.description: If > 0, runs a faster version of the script. Only for testing (default = 0).
test_debug_mode.title: Test / debug mode
